column1: # Short card names, our own English, used only where a card name is drawn in the mini font (8x7)
# and does not fit its slot even in tight spacing: in practice the battle card panel (96 px, the
# narrower of its two sides; every name fits Edit Partner). Card names are drawn there in
# capitals (7 px each, 'I' 1 px, 1 px gaps: about 12 letters, no more than 96 px). Everywhere
# else, including the card info in the main font, the full US name stays.
# card number<TAB>short name<TAB>full US name (checked against the US CARD2.CDD, for review)
# Written in capitals as drawn (the runtime folds to capitals anyway). Styles: a one-letter or
# two-letter prefix with a period for the long Digimon prefixes (M./MT./MG. for Mega/Metal, W.
# for Were/Waru ...), a dropped letter where that still reads (MARINANGEMON), and the US's own
# src/game/overrides/mini_text.cpp. Capital widths (px, normal / tight spacing) in the comments;
